phases_and_microstructures.name: acicular secondary alpha (alpha_s)
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: solution treated at 1000 °C for 2 h and air-cooled

evidence.quote: after solution treatment at 1000 ℃ for 2 h, fine needle-like αs are apparent.
the large-size α phase present in the microstructure is composed of the undissolved αp phase within the β grains and the αGB precipitated along the β grain boundaries.
the αGB precipitated along the β grain boundaries. Compared to the lower volume fraction of αGB phase, the matrix is mostly composed of αs and a small amount of residual β phase.

mechanisms.name: precipitation strengthening
mechanisms.material_state: solution treated at 1000 °C for 2 h and aged

evidence.quote: nanoscale silicides can pin dislocations during the high-temperature tensile process, thereby hindering dislocation motion and providing precipitation hardening. Consequently, this enhances the high-temperature strength of the alloy.

crack nucleation occurs at the interface between microscale silicides and the matrix. Under high-temperature tensile conditions, the microscale brittle silicides exhibit strength exceeding that of the matrix... resulting in debonding and crack initiation
